about: The first byte selects mark lookup type 4 through 6 by remainder modulo 3. Bit 2 wraps the lookup in an extension. The next bytes select signed anchor coordinates and repeat count. ff selects the real David Libre font with a feature setting and UTF-8 text.

seeds.why: Type 5 with a default last component
Type 6 stack wrapped in an extension
RTL Hebrew with a mark-to-mark accent stack
